info.description: REST API for a home-appliance store: clients, products, suppliers, and product images.
info.title: ShopAPI

post.description: Checks the email and password in the auth service and returns a signed JWT token. Does not require authentication.

400.description: invalid request body or validation error

get.description: Returns clients filtered by name and surname, or a paginated list of all clients if no filter is given

400.description: invalid limit or offset value

post.description: Creates a new client along with a new address record, in a single transaction.

400.description: invalid request body or validation error

delete.description: Deletes an existing client without deleting his address

400.description: invalid id format

patch.description: Creates a new address record and links it to the client, in a single transaction

400.description: invalid request body, id format, or validation error

get.description: Returns the raw image bytes by the image's unique identifier

400.description: invalid id format

delete.description: Deletes an image by its unique identifier; the owning product's image_id is set to null

400.description: invalid id format

patch.description: Replaces the bytes of an existing image by its ID

400.description: invalid id format or failed to read request body

get.description: Returns a paginated list of products with available_stock greater than zero

400.description: invalid limit or offset value

post.description: Creates a new product; finds or creates the category by name, in a single transaction

400.description: invalid request body or validation error

get.description: Returns a single product by its unique identifier

400.description: invalid id format

delete.description: Deletes a product by its unique identifier

400.description: invalid id format

get.description: Returns the raw image bytes linked to the given product

400.description: invalid id format

404.description: product not found or has no image

post.description: Uploads raw image bytes and links them to the given product, in a single transaction
post.summary: Add an image to a product

400.description: invalid id format or failed to read request body

patch.description: Atomically decreases available_stock by the given amount, failing if not enough stock is available

400.description: invalid request body, id format, or non-positive amount

404.description: product not found or insufficient stock

post.description: Creates a new user in the auth service and returns a signed JWT token. Does not require authentication.

get.description: Returns a single supplier by their unique identifier
